historical_record.description: Albion Hall, known as Equality Hall in 1931 and owned by the Workman's Educational Association, a German fraternal organisation; later the home of Gay Games founder Dr. Tom Waddell from 1975 until 1987, who held the planning meetings that launched the 1982 Gay Games here.
